description: Use this when a webhook source should stop accepting requests. Requires auth. Inputs: inbox_id (omit when this key is limited to one inbox), source_id (wsrc_…). The public URL starts returning HTTP 404 immediately. Returns {object:"webhook_source", id, deleted:true}. An unknown id is HTTP 404 webhook_source_not_found.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id, username, or email. Omit it when this key is limited to one inbox.

name: cooper_webhook_source_delete

deleted.description: True when the object was deleted.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

title: Delete a webhook source
